sources.name: Chicago building permits

terms_checked.note: City of Chicago Data Portal SODA. robots.txt allows /resource/ for User-agent * with Crawl-delay 1. Public open data, not a certified permit record. Owner and contractor names are copied only from contact slots whose contact_N_type says owner or contractor.

sources.notes: Verified 2026-10-26: a $limit=1 query ordered by issue_date returned permit_, issue_date, reported_cost, work_description, permit_type, work_type, latitude, and longitude, plus contact_1_type through contact_3_type. contact_15_type is a real column. The extract has no property ZIP, so zip is left blank. No contractor license column.

sources.name: New York City DOB NOW approved permits

terms_checked.note: NYC Open Data SODA resource rbx6-tga4 (DOB NOW: Build - Approved Permits), catalog data_updated_at 2026-11-10. robots.txt is User-agent * with Crawl-delay 1 and does not disallow /resource/ (only /api/odata/, /api/collocate*, and browse/search query URLs). Public open data, not a certified permit record. owner_business_name is the owner entity DOB publishes; the personal owner_name column is not copied.

sources.notes: Verified 2026-11-11: $order=issued_date DESC with issued_date <= 2026-11-11 returned work_permit, issued_date 2026-11-09, work_type, filing_reason, job_description, estimated_job_costs, house_no, street_name, borough, zip_code, latitude, longitude, applicant_business_name, applicant_license, owner_business_name. Rows with a null issued_date sort first without the window, so the date filter is required. filing_reason values since 2026-10-01 were Initial Permit (12215), Renewal Permit Without Changes (5893), Renewal Permit with Changes (1628), No Work Permit (76), None (63); only Initial Permit is queried so renewals are not resold as new leads. The older DOB Permit Issuance resource ipu4-2q9a is still not used.

sources.name: New Orleans permits

terms_checked.note: City of New Orleans open data SODA resource rcm3-fn58 (Permits), catalog data_updated_at 2026-11-11. robots.txt is User-agent * with Crawl-delay 1 and does not disallow /resource/. Public open data, not a certified permit record. The city publishes an owner column, so owner_name is filled.

sources.notes: Verified 2026-11-11: $order=issuedate DESC with issuedate <= 2026-11-11 returned numstring 26-32978-EVAC issued 2026-11-10 with type, code, description, constrval, address, owner, contractors, applicant, currentstatus, and location_1 {latitude, longitude}. No ZIP column. The feed mixes building, trade (electrical, plumbing), and pool permits; type text drives permit_category. Building Permits (2018-present) nbcf-m6c2 was last updated 2025-08-17 and is not used.

sources.notes: Verified 2026-11-11: $order=issueddate DESC with issueddate <= 2026-11-11 returned permitnum 2026P09571 issued 2026-11-09 with description, permittypemapped, workclassmapped, estprojectcostdec, originaladdress1, originalcity, originalstate, originalzip, companyname, and link (CAGIS record page). companyname arrives wrapped in literal double quotes, which the mapper strips. description repeats the permit type; there is no free-text scope.
